title: Recommendations
subtitle: AI suggestions for your campaigns. Nothing changes without your approval.
selectClient: Select a client to get started.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noneNew: No new recommendations. Your campaigns look fine for now.
emptyHint: We check your campaigns every week. Press “Analyze now” to check right away. Small budgets are not judged until they have spent at least $20 in 7 days.
reconnectHint: TikTok no longer lets WOB read or manage your ads. Reconnect TikTok and allow ads management.
noAccountHint: Connect your TikTok ad account to get recommendations.
viewOnly: Only the agency owner or an admin can apply this.
campaignFunnel: Campaign “{{name}}”, last 7 days in WOB: {{chats}} chats, {{qualified}} qualified, {{clients}} clients, {{revenue}} revenue.
confirmDismiss: This recommendation will move to history. Nothing changes on TikTok.

confirmApply.pause: WOB will pause “{{name}}” on TikTok now. You can turn it back on in TikTok Ads Manager at any time.
confirmApply.increase_budget: WOB will raise the daily budget of “{{name}}” by 20% (about ${{from}} → ${{to}}, worked out again from the live budget).
confirmApply.decrease_budget: WOB will lower the daily budget of “{{name}}” by 20% (about ${{from}} → ${{to}}, never under $20).

expected.pause: the money this ad spends moves to the ads in the same ad group that bring qualified leads.
expected.increase_budget: more qualified leads from your cheapest ad group (daily budget about {{from}} → {{to}}).
expected.decrease_budget: less money spent where qualified leads cost the most (daily budget about {{from}} → {{to}}).
expected.switch_event: TikTok shows your ads to people likely to buy. This needs a new ad group optimized for Purchase, because TikTok does not allow changing it on a running one.
expected.switch_event_not_yet: none yet. Keep optimizing for qualified leads until this ad group gets about 50 purchases a week.
expected.refresh_creative: a fresh video usually brings the click rate back up. Create one, then pause the tired ad.
expected.not_delivering: your ads show again once the cause is fixed. Check that the ad account has balance and the ads were not rejected in TikTok Ads Manager.
expected.no_chats: clicks that start chats. Check that your WhatsApp number is connected, the first message is right and the ad opens WhatsApp.

summary.title: What was checked
summary.line: Last 7 days: {{spend}} spent, {{clicks}} clicks, {{chats}} chats started. {{groups}} active ad groups, {{judged}} spent enough to be judged.
summary.none: No active ad groups found, so there is nothing to judge yet.
summary.why: A budget change or a pause is only suggested after an ad group spends {{min}} in 7 days, so small tests are left alone. Warnings (ad stopped, clicks without chats, weak video) appear sooner.
